get.description: Paginated teams list. Filter by country (ISO-2), league, season, name, or competition status. Spatial / squad data is not in this list — fetch it from `/teams/{id}/squad/` or `/teams/{id}/fixtures/`.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. PT, ES, BR). Unknown codes return an empty list.

parameters.name: in_competition
parameters.description: Set true for teams with upcoming matches in the league. Requires `league_id`; otherwise responds 400.

parameters.name: is_women
parameters.description: Filter by women / men competitions (requires `league_id` or `season_id` to apply).

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: Teams that have at least one event in this league.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on team name.

parameters.name: season_id
parameters.description: Teams that participated in this season.

get.description: Active players currently linked to this team via `current_team`. Final shape will be defined in the players-schema pass.
Matches for this team. Defaults to a window of `now - 3h` to `now + 7d` when no date filters are provided. Final response shape will be aligned with `/api/v2/events/` in the schema pass.

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: Restrict to fixtures in this league.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by match status.

get.description: Paginated tweets and video highlights linked to this team. Cached 15 min.
Standings for one season (defaults to current). Cup competitions return a `groups` map; league competitions return a flat `standings` array.

parameters.name: season_id
parameters.description: Season ID. Defaults to the league's current season.

get.description: Top players in one season for a given stat: `scorers` (goals), `assists`, `yellowcards`, `redcards`, or `fouls`. Defaults to the league's current season.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of players to return (default 20, max 50).

parameters.name: season_id
parameters.description: Season ID. Defaults to the league's current season.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: Which leaderboard to return.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Stats logged with this team (handles transfers).
